generation.prompt: ONE new complete Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky ground map, based on the two supplied ROM reference images for the exact grey stone material, cracked neutral grey ground, sharp dark contours, layered charcoal rocks and native DS pixel scale. WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3, ideally 1200 x 900, zoomed out, overhead PMD camera, not perspective. This is the END clearing of the Grey Rock Defile, a different layout from the entrance reference: a vast enclosed oval natural stone amphitheatre, asymmetric high grey cliff masses filling the entire north, west and east edges. A narrow grey floor corridor enters only from the SOUTH centre, opening into a large empty oval flat cracked grey floor. At the NORTH end the floor meets a solid natural semicircular wall of layered grey rock, with a slightly raised natural rock ridge behind it, but NO stairs, no dais, no altar, no seal, no building, no black cave hole and no other exit. Two coherent clusters of large layered rocks at the far left and far right rim only, never in the central floor. Some bare twisted dead roots near the rocky edges. Keep a large completely clear connected central ground. Match the original reference's medium neutral-grey floor and subtly darker rocks: not blue, not pale silver, no green, no brown. Edges filled with rocks, no sky, no void, no magenta, no liquid. Hard pixel-art edges, restrained palette. No characters, no text, no UI, no sparkles, no symbols. One single image, not a sheet.

Make the left and right cliff masses deeper and more irregular, asymmetrical and tall, with the same native PMD DS rock texture and palette as the second ROM reference. The viewer is inside a vast rocky mountain basin, not looking at a small island. Preserve a large open connected floor and the south arrival. Natural geological forms only: no stairs, no platform, no altar, no seal, no doorway, no black cave opening, no sky, no water, no symbols, no characters, no text or UI. generation.note: Le sol complet precedent est conserve comme support sous les masses. Le sol visible est extrait de ce nouveau decor.

normalization.method: BOX pondéré par classe, vote maximal, palette commune 96, sans dither

floor_support.note: support texture indépendant, non aligné ; sol visible issu du décor

segmentation.shadows: luminance lissee 5 px < 125 dans le sol existant
segmentation.talus: bande de 24 px autour du sol, bloquante
segmentation.details: racines et aiguilles conservees avec les parois

dust.law: k=(t+phase)%24 ; visible k<18 ; x=x0+k-9 ; y=y0+round(2 sin(2 pi k/18))
dust.origin: calculee, couleurs exactes du rip ; pas une animation officielle
